init_NoisyChannelBeamSearch: create a NoisyChannelBeamSearch instance with a target dictionary for noisy channel beam search decoding
combine_fw_bw_noisy_channel: combine forward and backward log-probs using the noisy channel method with step normalization
combine_fw_bw_lm_only: combine forward cumulative and backward log-probs using the lm_only method without normalization
step_beam_search: run one step of noisy channel beam search selecting top-k hypotheses by combined score
init_buffers: initialize score, index, beam, forward, and language model score buffers on the target device
